review.summary: The recommendation review could not finish. The saved analysis provides a provisional panel.

ranking_use.off_target: Comparable search scopes, count units and tissue evidence only
ranking_use.motifs: Only applicable or explicit user flags affect ordering; published flags never imply universal toxicity
ranking_use.duplex_reference: Descriptive reference proxy; never maximized as a potency score
ranking_use.cryptic_splice_evidence: Review flags with exact genomic scope; no validated biological cutoff is assumed

flags.context: CpG-associated innate immune recognition depends on chemistry, methylation, sequence and species; a sequence match alone does not predict toxicity.

motifs.interpretation: Absence of these motif flags is not evidence of safety.

splice_safeguards.scope: Recorded perturbation bounds; a pass is not proof of cellular neutrality.

duplex_reference.limitation: Perfect-match unmodified reference at 1 M sodium. Modified ASOs (including 2MOE and PS) have no validated parameters in this calculation. This is not their measured affinity, Kd, potency or specificity; larger Tm is not automatically better.

human.genomic_search: Bowtie ungapped alignments with up to 2 substitutions, all reported alignments up to mapper cap
human.genomic_strand_policy: Bowtie searches both genomic strands; the SAM alignment strand must match the GTF transcript strand because the query is transcript-oriented target RNA in the DNA alphabet. Opposite-strand exon overlaps are not counted; unresolved strand assignments make the count incomplete.
human.junction_search: annotated transcript exon junctions from genome FASTA and GTF

off_target_count_scope.metric: distinct annotated non-target gene screening count; not a genome-wide binding or safety count
off_target_count_scope.count_unit: unique version-stripped GTF gene IDs; union of genomic-exon and adjacent-junction hits
off_target_count_scope.genomic_search: Bowtie 1: -a -f -v 2 -y -m 2000 --max <overmapped.fasta> --sam --sam-nohead --no-unal --seed 1; seed length equals shortest query length
off_target_count_scope.counted_genomic_rna_universe: Only ungapped genomic hits wholly contained within an annotated GTF exon contribute genes. Intronic-only and intergenic hits do not contribute to this count.
off_target_count_scope.genomic_strand_policy: Bowtie searches both genomic strands; the SAM alignment strand must match the GTF transcript strand because the query is transcript-oriented target RNA in the DNA alphabet. Opposite-strand exon overlaps are not counted; unresolved strand assignments make the count incomplete.
off_target_count_scope.junction_search: Enumerate windows spanning each pair of adjacent annotated exons in transcript order, using reference genome bases and GTF strand; require at least one query base on each side. Windows spanning more than one junction are not enumerated.
off_target_count_scope.junction_strand_policy: Transcript-oriented junction sequence must match the recorded query with at most 2 substitutions; the junction search does not additionally reverse-complement the query.
off_target_count_scope.mismatch_policy: Ungapped substitutions from 0 through 2, classified by exact Hamming distance. Higher mismatch bins are unsearched.
off_target_count_scope.mismatch_bin_count_unit: Distinct genes within each distance bin; a gene can occur in several bins. The total is a deduplicated union, not the sum of bins.
off_target_count_scope.weighted_risk_definition: Unvalidated screening heuristic: sum of each bin's distinct gene count divided by (1 + substitutions); not measured affinity, safety or potency.
off_target_count_scope.indel_policy: ungapped matching; insertion/deletion alignments not searched
off_target_count_scope.intended_target_exclusion: Exclude the entire target gene, including all its transcripts and loci, by version-stripped gene ID; not just the requested site or transcript.
off_target_count_scope.reference_gap_recovery: Masked exon bases are recovered from checksum-verified, version-matched published transcripts; exon lengths and known genomic bases must agree. Recovered exon windows and adjacent junctions are screened at the same substitution budget.
off_target_count_scope.limitations: Does not establish binding outside the recorded substitution budget, intronic/pre-mRNA or experimental selectivity. Exon and adjacent-junction screening is not an exhaustive full-transcriptome search. Same-gene isoform selectivity is outside this count. Inspect the per-row query sequence/role and completeness status before interpreting a zero.

off_target.limitation: Counts are scoped computational matches, not established RNA binding or cellular off-target effects. Missing counts are never zero.
